project.project_description: Purchase of ten single-phase pad-mounted distribution transformers in four capacity groups.

package_subscope: Ten reconditioned single-phase pad-mounted transformers: two 167 kVA, two 100 kVA, three 50 kVA, and three 25 kVA units.

initial_state.boundary: Buyer-authored requirements and solicitation metadata only; excludes supplier responses, offered prices, negotiations, awards, and later outcomes.

technical_specifications.summary: Reconditioned single-phase pad-mounted transformer; 4160 GRDY/2400 high voltage, 120/240 V low voltage, specified taps and accessories.

schedule.delivery_requirement: Contract work must start within one month and be completed within four months of Notice of Commencement.

supplier_eligibility_constraints: Bidder must possess necessary licenses, permits, insurance, equipment, trained personnel, and experience.
Bidder must have successfully provided similar equipment at no fewer than five municipal or commercial locations within the past five years.
certifications_compliance: Transformer testing requirements include turns-ratio, polarity/phase-relation, DC hipot, core-loss/excitation, load/no-load, and induced-potential tests.
